column1: # The one version of each package that the workflow is not held to.
# //tools/registry-trust:check fails on any released version the registry does
# not show as published by the mirror's workflow. A row here is the exception:
# the LAST version of a package published before the workflow could prove
# itself. That version, and any the registry got before it, are history. Every
# version after it must be the workflow's.
# One row a package at most. The check refuses a second row, a row for a
# package that is not in the inventory, a row for a version the registry does
# not have, and a row for a version the workflow published.
# A new package gets its row in the pull request that records its one-time
# first publish (docs/engineering/registry-trust.md). Nothing else adds a row.
# Five fields, with a tab between each:
